prompt: What is the operational scope and boundary of ExLearn
options: An independent educational simulator that does not issue certification or conformity approvals
An accredited Ex Certification Body (ExCB) authorized to evaluate equipment
A Recognized Training Provider (RTP) formally registered with IECEx
A statutory body empowered to award Certificates of Personnel Competence (CoPC)
explanation: ExLearn is an independent educational simulator for personal learning. It is not an ExCB or RTP and has no statutory authority to certify persons or equipment.', relatedLessonId: 'ex-orientation

prompt: What status is conferred upon a user who completes modules and checks in ExLearn
options: Formal statutory qualification as an Ex-competent person under IECEx 05
Official certificate of conformity for installed electrical equipment
Educational practice and self-assessment records for learning purposes only
Legal sign-off granting compliance approval under workplace safety legislation
explanation: Completing ExLearn activities provides educational practice records only. It does not grant legal approvals, equipment conformity, or professional qualifications.', relatedLessonId: 'copc-rtp-excb

prompt: Under IEC 60079-10-1 and IEC 60079-10-2, which factors are primary inputs for hazardous area classification
options: Only the nominal operating voltage and power factor of nearby machinery
The structural steel building foundations and mechanical pipe support spacing
Flammable substance properties, sources and grades of release, and ventilation effectiveness
The acoustic noise emissions and thermal dissipation of nearby mechanical rotating equipment
explanation: Hazardous area classification depends on substance characteristics (such as flash point, LEL, and auto-ignition temperature), grades of release, and ventilation degree and availability.', relatedLessonId: 'hazardous-areas

prompt: Why are combustible dust layers considered a primary explosion risk in hazardous areas
options: They continuously raise the minimum ignition energy required for dust clouds
They eliminate smouldering risks by forming an oxygen-tight crust over surfaces
They prevent electrical tracking across high-voltage terminal insulators
They thermally insulate hot surfaces and can be disturbed into explosive dust clouds
explanation: Dust layers act as thermal insulation, causing surface temperatures to rise and potentially smoulder, and can be disturbed by shock or draughts into an explosive dust cloud.', relatedLessonId: 'gas-vapour-mist-dust

prompt: What does an Equipment Protection Level (EPL) indicate under IEC 60079-0
options: The level of protection assigned to equipment based on its likelihood of becoming an ignition source in explosive gas or dust atmospheres
A complete site installation authorization that bypasses hazardous area zone matching
A certified log proving that equipment has undergone all required periodic inspections
A credential certifying the technical competence of the installation technician
explanation: An Equipment Protection Level (EPL, such as Ga/Gb/Gc or Da/Db/Dc) defines the risk of the equipment becoming an ignition source under normal operation, expected malfunction, or rare malfunction.', relatedLessonId: 'zones-and-epl

prompt: What is the correct procedure when an equipment marking (e.g. EPL Gc) conflicts with the hazardous area classification schedule (e.g. Zone 1 requiring Gb)
options: Energize the equipment if external housing seals appear clean and undamaged
Hold acceptance, control the condition, and obtain documented engineering verification
Remove the nameplate marking and commission under general industrial procedures
Assume the equipment certificate automatically invalidates the area classification drawing
explanation: An EPL mismatch indicates a potential ignition protection deficit; acceptance must be held and escalated for competent engineering review before energization.', relatedLessonId: 'equipment-selection-marking

prompt: Which condition can compromise the explosion protection capability of an Ex d flameproof enclosure
options: Conducting an initial inspection in accordance with IEC 60079-17
Applying approved non-setting, non-metallic grease to machined joint surfaces
Exceeding maximum permitted flamepath gaps, using wrong fastener grades, or unapproved drilling
Fitting certified stopping plugs of matching thread form and property class
explanation: Flameproof integrity depends on strict flamepath dimensions, fastener tensile strength to withstand explosion pressure, and certified entry integrity.', relatedLessonId: 'ex-d-ex-e

prompt: What is fundamental when assessing an intrinsically safe (Ex i) installation under IEC 60079-14 and IEC 60079-25
options: Verifying that the external enclosure provides an ingress protection rating of at least IP66
Ensuring internal overpressure is monitored with a certified differential pressure sensor
Measuring flamepath joint clearances with calibrated non-metallic feeler gauges
Matching complete circuit entity parameters (Ui, Ii, Pi, Ci, Li) and cable characteristics
explanation: Intrinsic safety is a system concept requiring verification that the energy-limiting apparatus, interconnecting cable, and field device satisfy combined electrical parameters.', relatedLessonId: 'ex-i-ex-t-ex-p

prompt: Does a compliant equipment Ex certificate and nameplate marking alone confirm that an installation is safe to energize
options: No, complete installed conditions including cable glands, earthing, environmental limits, and IEC 60079-14 compliance must be verified
Yes, a certified nameplate guarantees complete installation integrity regardless of workmanship
Only if the certified apparatus was manufactured within the preceding twelve calendar months
Only when installed in Zone 2 or Zone 22 areas where explosive atmospheres are unlikely
explanation: Certification proves that the apparatus meets manufacturing standards, but safe operation requires verifying complete installed conditions, cable glands, earthing, and IEC 60079-14 compliance.', relatedLessonId: 'equipment-selection-marking

prompt: What is the required response when an undocumented physical modification is discovered on certified Ex equipment during an installation check
options: Accept the modification if the equipment has passed an insulation resistance test
Record the non-conformity, control the equipment status, and route through formal change evaluation
Conceal the altered component and commission the circuit if production is scheduled
Modify the equipment marking tag on site to match the as-found physical arrangement
explanation: Uncontrolled modifications can invalidate certification and protection. The discrepancy must be documented and reviewed under formal management of change.', relatedLessonId: 'installation-fundamentals

prompt: Under IEC 60079-17, what elements are necessary for an Ex inspection finding to be technically defensible and actionable
options: A generalized note stating that the overall equipment condition appears satisfactory
An unannotated photograph filed without equipment tag numbers or location details
Clear asset identification, location, specific observation referenced to standards, assigned priority, and designated action owner
An informal verbal notification given to operating personnel during shift change
explanation: An effective inspection finding links traceable asset identification with precise physical observations, standard non-conformity references, and responsible ownership.', relatedLessonId: 'ex008-inspection

prompt: What must occur before Ex equipment is returned to service following an overhaul or repair where documentation is incomplete
options: Immediate energization if the apparatus operates normally under no-load testing
Assumption that certified protection integrity is preserved if original bolts are fitted
Discarding the repair paperwork to avoid conflicting historical maintenance records
Maintaining the asset in a safe isolated state until verified by competent personnel in accordance with IEC 60079-19
explanation: IEC 60079-19 governs repair and overhaul. If evidence is uncertain, equipment must not be returned to hazardous service without competent technical review.', relatedLessonId: 'maintenance-repair-overhaul

prompt: Which statement accurately describes certification boundaries under the IECEx System
options: ExLearn is an independent educational tool; it is not an ExCB or RTP and cannot issue a Certificate of Personnel Competence (CoPC)
Recognized Training Providers (RTPs) and Ex Certification Bodies (ExCBs) perform identical conformity assessment roles
Completing interactive training quizzes automatically qualifies an engineer for an IECEx Certificate of Personnel Competence
A passing score on a simulator quiz serves as formal certification to authorize hazardous area electrical installations
explanation: ExLearn is an educational learning simulator only. Formal certification requires an accredited ExCB following the IECEx 05 scheme rules.', relatedLessonId: 'copc-rtp-excb

prompt: What is the defensible technical response when inspection evidence or certificate data for an Ex asset is incomplete
options: Proceed with sign-off based on assumptions from adjacent equipment of similar appearance
Record the specific evidence gap, maintain safe control, and escalate for technical verification
Select the least restrictive compliance interpretation to avoid maintenance delays
Assume default Zone 2 conformity without checking the equipment nameplate or certificate schedule
explanation: In hazardous areas, incomplete evidence constitutes an uncontrolled risk. The gap must be recorded, controlled, and formally resolved.', relatedLessonId: 'competence-and-responsibilities

prompt: During an integrated hazardous area review, how must a conflict between the area classification drawing and installed equipment protection level be handled
options: Disregard the discrepancy if the equipment has been functioning without incident
Default unconditionally to the oldest archive drawing without field verification
Document the conflict, maintain safe control of the plant, and obtain formal engineering verification
Authorize the most capital-intensive equipment replacement without investigating the release basis
explanation: An integrated review must make evidence conflicts visible, ensure immediate safety control, and engage responsible engineering disciplines to resolve the basis of safety.', relatedLessonId: 'integrated-ex-workshop
